stages.name: Price elasticity of demand
stages.title: Price elasticity of demand
stages.sub: How strongly buyers react when the price changes, and what that does to a firm's revenue.

steps.q: A shop sells 100 pizzas at £10 each. How much money comes in from the sales?
steps.right: £1,000: the price times the number sold
steps.wrong: £10: the price of a single pizza

steps.right: Percentage change in quantity demanded divided by percentage change in price
steps.wrong: Change in price in pounds divided by the change in revenue in pounds
steps.hint: Responsiveness compares two percentage changes: the one in quantity against the one in price.
